description: Generic halal guard policy — single invariant ranking halal-blind, view-only filter at S6 advisory. Tiers strict/flexible/off.

strict.note: Strict: L1 universal_haram + tobacco, L2 D/E<=0.5 LT<=0.2, L5 DSES membership required

flexible.note: Flexible: L1 universal + tobacco, L2 D/E<=0.8, L5 advisory only

off.note: Off: no halal filter, debt gate 1.0 passthrough

L1.note: sector_map overrides Food_Beverage for BATBC to Tobacco; universal_haram + halal_sensitive merged per tier

dses.note: DSES Shariah index membership checked as-of; data_gaps if unavailable

candidate_universe.note: Guard applied after ranking; view-only filter at S6

purification.note: purification_rate = max(0, debt_equity / gate) * 0.05 capped 0.05; 0 if clean
